brad-w-crihfield.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party (2026 general election).

source.title: Los Angeles County Democratic Party: November 3, 2026 General Election endorsements

brad-w-crihfield.text: Endorsed by the Bellflower Teachers Association (BTA).

source.title: Re-elect Brad Crihfield 2026, BUSD Trustee Area 5: home page

brad-w-crihfield.text: Lists safety steps taken during his tenure: armed security on high school campus perimeters, more security staff, vape detectors, K-9 drug detection, and a standing safety committee.

Says the board 'raised teacher salaries from among the lowest to among the most competitive in the region,' increased professional development, approved early-retirement incentives and added school-site support staff.
Cites transparency steps: hired BUSD's first public information officer, began live-streaming board meetings, and added live captioning and Spanish translation.

Cites launching BUSD's first artificial intelligence pathway, more career technical education offerings, and an MOU to expand Special Olympics programs; as board president in 2024 he prioritized the Mayfair athletic fields project.
(2024) As board president, voted for the contract settlement and termination of Superintendent Dr. Ben Drati; three members voted yes and one abstained.

source.title: Los Cerritos Community News: Bellflower Unified board fires Superintendent Dr. Drati (2024-02-09)

brad-w-crihfield.text: A special education parent, he says the role is personal and drives him 'to fight for the resources, fairness, and accountability our students deserve.'

source.title: Re-elect Brad Crihfield 2026: Why I'm Running
